result.summary:
One group spec (112,166 bytes, pure ASCII, LF) with section 0, house sections 1-11 for each of the four units, and section 12 for the group. Every file:line was read at 0b19de5b. Key design choices:
- S81-18: a NEW leaf app/services/kb_serve.py. One gathered task of two kb_product_card RPCs through run_db, started before the product gather (H0). Inside _fetch_product_data, slots H1-H6 classify full / partial / miss and swap the live coroutines for served values. A full hit skips search, price, specs, reviews, image, rating, smart fallback and Tier 2/3. H7 adds metadata.kb_hit through _stamp_unit_metadata. H8 logs the verdict-cache key (eligible users only; seeded only after a successful verdict).
- The KB price is source_method page_scrape with an additive as_of. Fresh means within 7 d of last_seen; older prices are served only when the X-Client-Capabilities header lists price_asof. That header is read in the five route handlers through the house optional-kwarg idiom (kb_price_asof).
- A two-line kb_ingest guard stops G3 from re-observing a KB-served price (a self-freshening loop found by measurement).
- S81-19: scripts-only cron_kb_enrich.py plus railway.kbenrich.json. Ladder: specs go to licence; then registry search template, then pdp_ hints, then web search (INERT, logs not_built), then needs_operator. Redis SET NX EX single flight, fail-closed. PoliteFetcher with require_tos=True and a 4 s timeout. Head daily / tail weekly price refresh. No LLM call, so the breaker is never called; DRY prints the offclock cap.
- D16: app/services/kb_operator.py plus two include_in_schema=False routes on the existing admin router. The first dependency is a gate that raises the Starlette base-class 404, so flag OFF matches an unregistered path. verify_admin_key and the 30/min limiter are reused unchanged. The bookmarklet only copies to the clipboard, because CORS would refuse a direct post.
- D17: cron_kb_coverage.py plus railway.kbcoverage.json. A closed metric list, a search_logs PROXY that reads no personal columns, and kbh: host counters only when present. Upsert on (day, metric).
- Base run: 1609 passed, 5 environmental CRLF r27 failures. Comm set: 661 files, sha 90b85603...; 439 to recompute at 0b19de5b, the rest per-file reusable from the 744616e3 record.
